provenance.expectations: Explicit address lists and byte fields derived from tmem-direction-v2.md sections 2 and 4; no production footprint builder or decoder is called.
provenance.hash_implementation: xxHash upstream C XXH3_64bits and reset/update/digest with seven-byte chunks, default seed and secret

vectors.name: tile-i8
vectors.distinguishes: Omitted byte address or value; host-endian/pointer-width serialization.

vectors.name: tile-i8-unused-palette-tlut
vectors.distinguishes: Non-CI palette/TLUT included in identity despite being ignored by decode.

vectors.name: tile-rgba16-base511
vectors.distinguishes: Base truncated to 8 bits, or big-endian texel bytes reinterpreted as host words.

vectors.name: tile-i4-odd-wrap
vectors.distinguishes: Traversal-order/duplicate hashing, lost final odd nibble, or lost wrapped odd-row addresses.

vectors.name: tile-ci4-bank15
vectors.distinguishes: Only used palette halfwords enter the sorted physical union; duplicate colours at distinct addresses remain distinct.

vectors.name: tile-ci8-tlut0
vectors.distinguishes: Consulted CI TLUT interpretation omitted or confused with shifted rt64 othermode encoding.

vectors.name: tile-ci8-tlut1
vectors.distinguishes: Consulted CI TLUT interpretation omitted or confused with shifted rt64 othermode encoding.

vectors.name: tile-ci8-tlut2
vectors.distinguishes: Consulted CI TLUT interpretation omitted or confused with shifted rt64 othermode encoding.

vectors.name: tile-ci8-tlut3
vectors.distinguishes: Consulted CI TLUT interpretation omitted or confused with shifted rt64 othermode encoding.

vectors.name: tile-ci8-unused-bank15
vectors.distinguishes: CI8 bank selector incorrectly included in identity.

vectors.name: tile-rgba32-two-banks
vectors.distinguishes: High bank omitted from encoded witness; RGBA32 effective size confused with per-bank byte addressing.

vectors.name: linear-i4-flat-odd
vectors.distinguishes: Linear encoded stream replaced by physical bank identity or row-aligned nibble layout.

vectors.name: linear-ci4-bank15
vectors.distinguishes: Linear palette snapshot omitted, palette visitation order retained, or duplicate colours collapse addresses.

vectors.name: lookup-i8-full-bank
vectors.distinguishes: Lookup footprint narrowed to nominal logical extent; long XXH3 inputs mishandled.

probe_scope: Raw serialization/hash probes; changed lengths, versions, representation and output encoding do not claim a valid admitted decode request.
